coordinate: Reception is free this afternoon, so can you coordinate the vendor visit?
接待处今天下午有空，你能去协调供应商来访吗？
facilitate: Monday's session for new hires still needs someone to facilitate it.
周一的新员工说明会还需要有人来促成。
prepare: Visitor badges take time, so prepare them before nine o'clock.
访客工牌要花时间，请在九点前准备好。
arrange: Please arrange the chairs before the vendor arrives.
厂商到之前请把椅子安排好。
organize: Someone needs to organize tea and cups for the all-staff meeting.
需要有人来组织全员大会的茶水和杯子。
book: Thursday's leaving conversation needs a room, and I will book one.
周四的离职谈话需要一间房，我来预订。
reserve: The interpreters need a clear view, so reserve two seats at the front.
口译员要看清现场，请在前排预留两个座位。
attend: Ask whether the sponsor can attend Thursday's meeting in person.
问问发起人能否亲自出席周四的会议。
chair: While the director travels, the deputy will chair that working session.
主任出差期间，由副主任主持那场工作会议。
host: The auditorium is free, so our office can host the quarterly staff meeting.
礼堂有空，所以我们科室可以主办季度员工大会。
moderate: Moderate the discussion and keep every speaker inside the agreed time.
请主持讨论，并让每位发言人守住约定的时间。
introduce: Before the briefing I will introduce the new person guiding the lobby.
情况说明之前，我会介绍新来的大厅引导员。
welcome: When the new clerks reach the counter, welcome them by name.
新文员走到柜台时，请称呼姓名欢迎他们。
thank: Thank the night crew when you see them; they covered the late clinic.
见到夜班同事时请感谢他们，晚间门诊是他们值的。
apologize: I apologize for the minutes; they went to the wrong mailbox.
纪要发错了邮箱，我为此道歉。
congratulate: She passed probation, so we should congratulate her before she leaves today.
她通过了试用，我们该在她今天下班前祝贺她。
raise: In the meeting, did you raise the problem of badges that never come back?
会上你提出工牌一直不归还的问题了吗？
address: Save the overtime questions; the chair will address them after the break.
加班的问题先放下，主持人会在休息后处理回应。
resolve: We still need to resolve the clash over the meeting room before ten.
我们仍需在十点前解决会议室的冲突。
settle: Today is a good day to settle the handover date with her supervisor.
今天适合和她的主管谈妥交接日期。
mediate: When the teams cannot agree on cover, ask HR to mediate.
各班组在顶班上谈不拢时，请人力资源来调解。
enforce: At the staff entrance, security has to enforce the rule about badges.
在员工入口，安保必须把工牌规定执行落实。
comply: Visitor rules are strict, and every on-site vendor must comply with them.
访客规定很严，所有在院供应商都必须遵守。
waive: If the lateness was payroll's fault, finance should waive the charge.
如果延误是薪酬处造成的，财务应豁免这笔费用。
grant: For the licensing exam, the director can grant two days away from the desk.
为了执业考试，主任可以批准离开柜台两天。
deny: Next week's roster is full, so HR will deny that extra leave.
下周排班已满，人力资源会拒绝批准那份额外的假。
permit: The file-room rules do not permit visitors at any time.
档案室的规定在任何时候都不允许访客进入。
restrict: Evening access to the file room is something we should restrict.
晚间进入档案室这件事，我们应该加以限制。
expand: They want to expand the enquiry desk while the morning queue is longest.
早晨排队最长的时候，他们希望扩大咨询台。
reduce: Reduce the wait at the main counter if we can do it without new staff.
如果不必加人，就尽量减少总柜台的等候时间。
maintain: While the clinics are running, maintain a calm and quiet lobby.
门诊开诊期间，请维持大厅平静安静。
improve: Improve the way numbers are called so people waiting can actually hear them.
请改进叫号方式，让等候的人真的能听清。
streamline: Streamline the sign-in steps so a family is not standing there for long.
请精简签到步骤，别让家属在那里站太久。
simplify: Simplify the leave form; a clerk on day one should manage to finish it.
请简化请假表，让入职第一天的文员也能填完。
standardize: Standardize the way we label filed copies so every folder matches.
请把归档副本的标注方式标准化，让每个文件夹都一致。
customize: Ask whether the supplier can customize desk cards for that meeting room.
问问供应商能否为那间会议室定制桌卡。
adapt: Give the new clerks time to adapt before you judge how fast they work.
在评价新文员干活快慢之前，先给他们时间调整适应。
adjust: Adjust the seat list slightly so both interpreters sit side by side.
请微调座位名单，让两位口译员并排就坐。
document: Document the decisions in writing before the room empties.
在人走光之前，请把各项决定形成书面记录。
record: Record how the vote went before people start leaving the room.
在大家开始离场之前，请记录表决的结果。
note: Note the names of anyone who came in late on the paper list.
请在纸质名单上记下所有迟到者的姓名。
translate: Find someone who can translate the consent page while the family waits.
请找人在家属等候时把同意书翻译出来。
explain: Explain the privacy sheet slowly, using simple words the family knows.
请用家属听得懂的简单词语，慢慢解释这份隐私说明。
describe: Describe how the chairs should be set so facilities can copy that layout.
请描述椅子该怎么摆，方便总务照着布置。
define: Define, in one sentence, who may approve a door pass on the same day.
请用一句话界定谁可以在当天批准门禁证。
specify: The updated duty list must specify the date it starts.
更新后的值班名单必须明确开始日期。
itemize: On the claim, itemize each overtime hour instead of giving one total.
在申报单上请逐项列出每一小时加班，不要只写一个总数。
compare: Compare visitor numbers for this month with the figures from last month.
请把这个月的访客人数和上个月的数字比较一下。
analyze: Please analyze why the May survey scores fell so far.
请分析五月调查分数为何掉了这么多。
calculate: Payroll, can you calculate Sunday's hours before Friday noon?
薪酬处，能在周五中午前把周日的工时计算出来吗？
plan: Plan the training days before those new screens are switched on.
在那些新显示屏启用之前，请先把培训日规划好。
initiate: Once she accepts, HR can initiate the review of her background.
她一接受录用，人力资源就可以启动背景审查。
launch: On the first of June we launch the new screen that calls the queue.
六月一日我们推出用来叫号的新屏幕。
pause: Until headcount is confirmed, we should pause any further hiring.
编制确认之前，我们应暂停继续招聘。
resume: Orientation can resume the morning our trainer is back in the office.
培训师回到办公室的那天上午，入职培训可以恢复进行。
suspend: Security can suspend a badge that is still missing at closing time.
到关门时还没归还的工牌，安保可以中止使用。
delay: A public holiday can delay the payroll cutoff, sometimes by a full day.
法定假日可能会延误薪酬截止时间，有时会晚一整天。
accelerate: If we accelerate the clearance papers, she can finish on Friday.
如果我们加快办理清算材料，她周五就能办完。
expedite: The new night clerk starts tomorrow, so please expedite her access form.
新来的夜班文员明天到岗，请加急办理她的权限表。
omit: Where a visitor has no middle name, omit that line on the form.
访客没有中间名时，表格上那一行可以省略。
include: Tomorrow's staffing list must include whoever is on the night shift.
明天的人员名单必须把夜班的人纳入进去。
exclude: Canceled visits should be easy to exclude from today's reception tally.
已取消的来访，应该很容易从今天的接待统计里排除。
replace: Take down the old entrance map and replace it with the new one.
把入口处的旧地图取下来，替换成新的。
combine: These two notes say the same thing, so combine them onto one page.
这两份说明内容相同，请把它们合并到一页上。
split: If the training day is too long, split it between morning and afternoon.
如果培训日太长，就把它拆成上午和下午。
track: Someone at reception should track badges that visitors have not returned.
接待处应该有人跟踪访客尚未归还的工牌。
measure: Every Monday morning we measure how long people wait at registration.
每周一上午，我们衡量人们在挂号处等候多久。
evaluate: After the visit, the review group will evaluate the two suppliers.
走访结束后，评审小组会评估这两家供应商。
assess: Before the probation meeting, HR will assess whether she is ready.
试用考核会之前，人力资源会评定她是否已经胜任。
train: This week, can you train the new clerks to call the queue?
这周你能培训新文员叫号吗？
coach: Coach him through one shift before you leave him on the counter alone.
先辅导他完成一个班次，再让他独自看柜台。
hire: Winter will be busy, so we hope to hire two more registration clerks.
冬天会很忙，所以我们希望再招聘两名挂号文员。
recruit: The outpatient desk is still trying to recruit a Saturday receptionist.
门诊台仍在招募一名周六的接待员。
nominate: I nominate our senior clerk to take the minutes at Thursday's meeting.
我提名我们的资深文员在周四的会上做记录。
appoint: Someone must appoint a new lead for registration before next month.
下个月之前，必须有人任命挂号处的新负责人。
promote: If this review goes well, HR will promote her to supervisor.
如果这次考核顺利，人力资源会把她晋升为主管。
relocate: They want to relocate her from the file room to the main desk.
他们想把她从档案室调岗到总服务台。
handover meeting: We set the handover meeting for eight, in the small conference room.
我们把交接会定在八点，地点是小会议室。
kick-off memo: Everyone in the working group should already have the kick-off memo.
工作组里的每个人现在应该都拿到启动备忘了。
closing remarks: Three minutes is the limit I want for the closing remarks.
我希望结束讲话不超过三分钟。
opening remarks: Opening remarks from the director begin as soon as people sit.
大家一坐下，主任的开场讲话就开始。
talking paper: Keep the talking paper to one page so the speaker can hold it.
请把发言提纲控制在一页，方便发言人拿在手里。
briefing note: The briefing note for the health-bureau visitors is attached to my mail.
给卫生局来访者的情况说明附在我的邮件里。
position paper: Draft a position paper before legal lets us answer that vendor.
在法务允许我们回复那家供应商之前，请先起草立场说明。
white paper: Please leave the white paper on queue redesign for the director.
请把关于排队改造的白皮书留给主任。
terms of reference: We cannot start until the terms of reference for the group are signed.
这个组的职责范围签了字，才能开始工作。
code of conduct: On their first morning, new staff sit down and read the code of conduct.
新员工第一个上午要坐下来阅读行为规范。
conflict of interest: Score no bids until each of you has declared any conflict of interest.
在各位都申报了利益冲突之前，先不要给标书打分。
declaration: Sign the declaration before you walk into the bid review meeting.
进入评标会之前，请先签署申报声明。
confidentiality: Leaving the department does not end your duty of confidentiality.
离开本部门并不会终止你的保密义务。
non-disclosure: They signed the non-disclosure and only then saw the system demo.
他们先签了保密约定，然后才看了系统演示。
privacy notice: At the desk, give each visitor a copy of the privacy notice.
在柜台请发给每位访客一份隐私告知。
data request: Finance's data request is sitting with the director for approval.
财务的数据申请正在主任那里等批准。
access request: Security is still holding her access request for the roster system.
安全组还压着她提交的排班系统权限申请。
change request: If we move registration to eight o'clock, file a change request first.
如果要把挂号时间改到八点，请先提交变更申请。
service request: Someone filed a service request this morning for an extra phone line.
今早有人提交了服务申请，要求加一条电话线。
work order: Facilities opened a work order this morning for the cracked display.
总务今早为那块裂开的显示屏开了派工单。
priority: How high a priority is the broken printer in the payroll office?
薪酬办公室那台坏打印机，优先级该定多高？
severity: The severity is high because patients can no longer hear their numbers.
严重程度很高，因为患者已经听不到自己的号码了。
impact: Only the afternoon registration desks feel the impact of this delay.
这次延误的影响，只有下午的挂号台感受得到。
urgency: Because payroll locks the file at four, the urgency is high.
薪酬处四点锁文件，所以紧急程度很高。
business hours: Calls to the enquiry desk are answered in business hours only.
咨询台的电话只在工作时间内接听。
after hours: Visitors who arrive after hours must sign in with the night guard.
下班后来访的人必须到夜班警卫处登记。
cut-off: Thursday at noon is the cut-off for this month's overtime claims.
本月加班申报的截止时点是周四中午。
lead-in: A good lead-in for this item should stay under one minute.
这个议题的开场铺垫最好控制在一分钟以内。
wrap-up email: Once the chair signs, I will send everyone the wrap-up email.
主持人一签字，我就把收尾邮件发给大家。
read receipt: Turn on a read receipt when you send the new policy announcement.
发送新的制度通知时，请打开已读回执。
delivery failure: Sending the roster to payroll produced a delivery failure this morning.
今早把排班表发给薪酬处时，出现了发送失败。
bounce: According to the bounce, her previous mailbox has been closed.
从退信来看，她以前的邮箱已经关闭了。
outbox: Look in the outbox; the announcement has not actually gone out.
看一下发件箱，那份通知其实还没发出去。
drafts folder: You still have that unfinished notice saved in the drafts folder.
那份没写完的通知还保存在草稿箱里。
junk mail: The vendor's answer may be sitting in the junk mail folder.
供应商的回复可能在垃圾邮件文件夹里。
recall: Recall the mail now, before staff across the clinic open it.
现在就撤回这封邮件，别等门诊各处的人打开它。
unsubscribe: There is an unsubscribe link at the bottom of that vendor newsletter.
那份供应商通讯的最下方有退订链接。
flag: Flag anything from the director so the team answers those mails first.
请把主任的来信标旗，让大家优先回复。
pin: Pin this roster notice and leave it at the top of the shared inbox.
请把这份排班通知置顶，留在共享收件箱的最上面。
archive folder: This week, shift last year's minutes across into the archive folder.
本周请把去年的会议纪要移到归档文件夹。
shared mailbox: Ask families to reply to the shared mailbox rather than to one person.
请家属回复共享邮箱，不要回复某一个人。
group email: Use the group email for the holiday roster instead of separate messages.
假期排班请发到组邮箱，不要一封封分开写。
email etiquette: A clear subject line and a polite greeting are basic email etiquette.
主题清楚、问候得体，这是基本的邮件礼仪。
plain language: Families will understand the notice better if we use plain language.
如果我们用通俗表达来写，家属会更容易看懂这份通知。
tone: That reminder's tone is too harsh for what should be a polite note.
那封提醒的语气太冲了，而这本该是一封客气的便函。
wording: Soften the wording before anyone sends this note out to the wards.
在把这份说明发给各病区之前，请先把措辞写得柔和些。
bullet point: Give every decision its own bullet point, one line each.
每项决定单独写成一个条目要点，各占一行。
call to action: Close the notice with a single, clear call to action.
通知的结尾要有一句明确的行动号召。
executive summary: On a crowded morning the director may read only the executive summary.
早上人多的时候，主任可能只看高管摘要。
cover letter: When the contract goes to legal, put a cover letter on the front.
合同送法务时，请在最前面附上说明函。
transmittal: List every attachment on the transmittal that goes with this packet.
请在随这套材料附上的送文单里列出每一份附件。
routing slip: Put a routing slip on the folder before it goes to the next office.
文件夹送到下一个办公室之前，请放上一张传阅单。
approval chain: Leave requests travel up the approval chain from supervisor to director.
请假单沿着审批链，从主管报到主任。
counter-sign: Before payroll runs, finance has to counter-sign every overtime claim.
发薪之前，每一份加班申报都要经财务会签。
wet signature: They will not accept the original without a wet signature.
原件上没有手写签名，他们不会收。
e-signature: For internal leave forms, an e-signature is all we need.
内部请假表有电子签名就够了。
initials: Write your initials in the margin beside each change you make.
请在你修改的每一处页边签上姓名缩写。
date stamp: As each form arrives, reception adds the date stamp.
每份表格一到，接待处就盖上日期章。
official seal: Nothing leaves this office until the official seal is on the letter.
信上盖了公章之后，才能拿出这个办公室。
letter of thanks: Yesterday we posted a letter of thanks to the volunteer office.
昨天我们给志愿服务办公室寄出了一封感谢信。
letter of complaint: This morning we received a letter of complaint about the long queue.
今早我们收到一封投诉信，说排队时间太长。
meeting pack: One meeting pack should be waiting on the table at every seat.
每个座位的桌上都应该放好一份会议材料包。
pre-read: Please read the pre-read tonight; it is only four pages long.
请今晚把会前阅读材料看完，一共只有四页。
post-meeting note: I can circulate the post-meeting note before I leave this evening.
我今晚离开之前可以把会后说明传阅出去。
action log: Put the due date and the responsible person on the action log.
请在行动清单上写上到期日和负责人。
risk log: The printer shortage belongs on the risk log for go-live week.
打印机不够这件事，应该记入上线那周的风险台账。
issue log: Those missing badges have already been written on the issue log.
那些不见的工牌已经写进问题台账了。
decision register: Before we adjourn, enter that decision in the decision register.
散会前，请把那项决定记入决策台账。
lessons log: Write the things that failed during the drill into the lessons log.
请把演练中没做好的地方写入经验台账。
project charter: Both the sponsor and the finish date are named in the project charter.
项目章程里写明了发起人和完成日期。
business case: Finance is still reading the business case for a second enquiry desk.
财务还在看增设第二个咨询台的立项论证。
feasibility: We need a brief feasibility note before anyone orders those screens.
订那些显示屏之前，我们需要一份简短的可行性说明。
go-live plan: In the go-live plan, training sits in the week before we open.
按照上线计划，培训安排在我们启用前的那一周。
training roster: Does Thursday's training roster include the people on night shift?
周四的培训名单里有夜班人员吗？
attendance sheet: Send the attendance sheet around the table before training begins.
培训开始前，请把签到表在桌上传递一圈。
feedback form: After class, put a feedback form on the seat of every chair.
下课之后，请在每张椅子上放一份反馈表。
satisfaction survey: Remember that the satisfaction survey closes at five on Friday.
请记住，满意度调查在周五五点截止。
pulse survey: This pulse survey only asks the front desk three short questions.
这次快问快答调查只向前台提三个简短问题。
town-hall Q&A: Keep the final ten minutes free for the town-hall Q&A.
请把最后十分钟留出来做全员问答。
open floor: Once the director sits down, we can have an open floor.
主任落座之后，我们可以自由发言。
time-box: Can we time-box every topic on today's agenda to five minutes?
我们能把今天议程上的每个议题都限时讨论五分钟吗？
any other business: Hold any other business until every listed item has been handled.
请把其他事项留到所列事项都处理完之后。
AOB: Before we adjourn, is there any AOB (Any Other Business)?
散会之前，还有其他事项吗？
meeting cadence: A thirty-minute Tuesday check is our usual meeting cadence.
每周二三十分钟的碰头，是我们通常的开会节奏。
biweekly: Put the biweekly roster meeting on the second and the fourth Monday.
请把双周一次的排班会放在第二个和第四个周一。
fortnightly: Those fortnightly chats with the clerks will start again in March.
和文员每两周一次的谈话将于三月重新开始。
quarterly: Our quarterly all-staff gathering is fixed for the first Wednesday.
我们每季度的全员聚会定在第一个星期三。
year-end: Have the year-end attendance figures ready by the last Friday.
请在最后一个周五之前准备好年底的出勤数字。
mid-year: The mid-year reviews for staff on probation start early in July.
试用人员的年中考核在七月初开始。
year to date: We have taken on four registration clerks, year to date.
年初至今，我们招了四名挂号文员。
month to date: Overtime is already over the monthly target, month to date.
月初至今，加班时数已经超过月度目标。
week to date: The enquiry desk has already seen ninety people, week to date.
咨询台本周至今已经接待了九十人。
effective date: Next Monday is the effective date printed on the new roster.
下周一就是新排班表上印的生效日期。
expiry date: Look at the expiry date before you hand that visitor badge out again.
再次发出那张访客工牌之前，请看一下到期日期。
grace period: Claims still have a three-day grace period after the due date.
申报到期之后，仍有三天宽限期。
notice period: Count her notice period as thirty days from the resignation email.
她的通知期从辞职邮件那天起算三十天。

parental leave: Parental leave may be taken in blocks during the baby's first year.
育儿假可以在宝宝出生后的第一年里分段休。
unpaid leave: Unpaid leave has to be approved by the director in writing.
无薪假必须经过主任的书面批准。
study leave: Study leave for her certificate course was approved yesterday afternoon.
她修读证书课程的进修假，昨天下午已经批准。
compassionate leave: Compassionate leave was approved so she can attend her father's surgery.
已经批准了恩恤假，让她能在父亲手术时陪同。
jury duty: He is away all next week because of jury duty.
他下周整周都不在，因为要去履行陪审公务。
military leave: Military leave has to be backed by the official call-up paper.
服役假必须附上正式的征召文件。
return-to-work: Her return-to-work day is the Monday right after the holiday.
她的复工日是假期结束后的那个周一。
fit note: She needs a fit note before she is cleared for full duties.
在被允许恢复全部工作之前，她需要一份康复证明。
sick note: Bring a sick note if you are away for more than two days.
如果缺勤超过两天，请带上病假条。
occupational health: Occupational health wants to see her before she returns to nights.
职业健康部门希望在她回到夜班之前先给她看诊。
pre-employment check: Her pre-employment check is booked at the staff clinic on Monday.
她的入职体检预约在周一的职工保健门诊。
background check: A standard background check here takes about five working days.
这里的常规背景审查大约需要五个工作日。
reference check: HR will complete a reference check with her last supervisor.
人力资源会向她的上一任主管做背景询问。
conflict check: Run a conflict check before you sit on the vendor scoring panel.
参加供应商评分小组之前，请先做利益冲突核查。
onboarding pack: The onboarding pack is waiting for her at the HR counter.
入职材料包在人力资源柜台等她来取。
welcome email: Send out the welcome email on the morning she picks up her badge.
请在她领工牌的那天早上发出欢迎邮件。
first-day agenda: Her first-day agenda begins with a short tour of registration.
她的首日安排从简短参观挂号处开始。
buddy assignment: The buddy assignment matches every new clerk with a senior colleague.
带教安排会给每位新文员配一名资深同事。
desk assignment: The desk assignment places the new clerk next to her supervisor.
工位安排把新文员放在她主管的旁边。
phone extension: Her new phone extension should be working on Monday morning.
她的新电话分机周一早上应该就能用了。
email account: The email account exists, but nobody has set the password yet.
邮箱账号已经建好了，但密码还没有人设置。
system access: System access to the roster tool is still with the security team.
排班工具的系统权限还在安全组那边。
training schedule: The May training schedule is posted in the staff room.
五月的培训日程贴在员工休息室里。
competency: Calling patients forward is a basic competency at this counter.
把患者叫到柜台前，是这个岗位的一项基本能力要求。
skill matrix: The skill matrix shows who can run the night registration desk.
技能矩阵上能看出谁可以值夜班挂号台。
job grade: Her job grade changes only if this promotion is approved.
只有这次晋升获批，她的职级才会变动。
pay band: That post sits in pay band four on the hospital pay scale.
这个岗位在医院薪级表上属于第四级。
title: The title on her desk card should say senior clerk.
她桌牌上的职务名称应该写资深文员。
reporting line: Her reporting line goes straight to the front-desk supervisor.
她的汇报关系直接对到前台主管。
dotted line: He also has a dotted line into the project office.
他同时还向项目办做虚线汇报。
solid line: Her solid line goes to the information-center director.
她的实线汇报对象是信息中心主任。
span of control: His span of control now covers twelve clerks at registration.
他现在的管理幅度覆盖挂号处的十二名文员。
acting: The acting supervisor can approve leave requests until June.
在六月之前，代理主管可以批准请假。
interim: An interim lead will run the desk while she is away on leave.
她休假期间，由一位临时负责人来看这个柜台。
permanent: The permanent post will be advertised once probation decisions are done.
试用期的决定做出之后，这个正式岗位就会对外公布。
temporary: We took on temporary clerks for the winter registration rush.
我们为冬季挂号高峰招了临时文员。
full-time: The full-time opening at reception closes for applications on Friday.
接待处这个全职空缺，周五停止接受申请。
part-time: A part-time clerk covers the enquiry desk on Saturday mornings.
周六上午由一名兼职文员看咨询台。
contract staff: Contract staff renew their contracts at the close of each year.
合同制员工在每年年底续签合同。
agency staff: Agency staff need their sponsor's signature before the first shift.
派遣员工第一次上班之前，需要担保人签字。
locum: A locum will cover the registration counter all of next week.
下周挂号柜台全程由代班人员顶着。
floater: The floater moves between counters whenever one queue grows long.
哪边队伍一变长，机动人员就调到哪个柜台。
pool staff: Pool staff can come in when two clerks call in sick together.
有两名文员同时请病假时，可以叫机动库人员来。
surge staff: Surge staff will join registration if the morning queue doubles.
如果早晨的队伍翻倍，应急增援人员就会加入挂号处。
overtime roster: The overtime roster for the holiday week is on the staff board.
假期那一周的加班排班贴在员工公告栏上。
swap shift: May I swap shift with you so I can go to the wedding?
我能和你换班吗？我想去参加婚礼。
cover shift: Can you cover shift for me on Thursday evening?
周四晚上你能帮我顶班吗？
no-pay day: An unexplained absence is entered as a no-pay day.
没有说明原因的缺勤会被记成无薪缺勤日。
tardiness: Repeated tardiness will come up at the monthly staff review.
反复的迟到记录会在月度员工考核时被提出来。
absenteeism: Absenteeism on Mondays has gone up since the roster changed.
排班调整之后，周一的缺勤上升了。
attendance record: Your attendance record is clear except for one late morning.
除了一个迟到的上午，你的出勤记录是干净的。
time sheet: Please sign the time sheet before you go home on Friday.
周五回家之前，请在工时表上签字。
hours worked: Hours worked last week include two night shifts and one Sunday.
上周的实际工时包括两个夜班和一个星期日。
core team: The core team meets for fifteen minutes at the start of each morning.
核心团队每天早晨开十五分钟的会。
extended team: The extended team joins the meeting only when we need them.
只有我们需要的时候，扩展团队才来参加会议。
project team: The project team will show the new calling screen on Friday.
项目组周五会展示新的叫号屏。
ops team: The ops team answers roster questions after the counter closes.
柜台关门之后，排班方面的问题由运营组答复。
support team: The support team stays behind the counter until six o'clock.
支持组在柜台后面一直待到六点。
frontline: Frontline clerks meet the queue before anyone sitting behind them.
一线文员比坐在后面的人更早面对排队的人群。
back office: Back office can make the badges while the front counter stays open.
前台柜台照常开放的时候，后台可以制作工牌。
shared services: Shared services prints staff badges for every clinical department.
共享服务为每个临床科室印制员工工牌。
help window: The help window stops new questions at half past four.
服务窗口从四点半起不再接受新问题。
service counter: Please wait at the service counter until your number is called.
请在服务台等候，直到叫到你的号码。
ticket window: Ticket window three is closed while the clerks take their meal.
三号窗口在文员吃饭的时候关闭。
queue number: Please hold your queue number until your name is called out.
在叫到你的名字之前，请拿好排队号。
calling system: The calling system skipped number forty-two during the morning rush.
叫号系统在早高峰的时候跳过了四十二号。
display board: The display board in the lobby shows which number is being called.
大厅的显示屏上能看到正在呼叫的号码。
wayfinding: The wayfinding toward the file room still confuses many visitors.
通往档案室的导引标识仍然让很多访客搞不清方向。
directory board: The directory board next to the lift lists every ward and clinic.
电梯旁边的楼层索引列出了每个病区和门诊。
floor plan: A floor plan for this wing is posted right beside the stairs.
这栋楼翼的平面图就贴在楼梯旁边。
room number: The room number printed on her badge does not match her seat.
她工牌上印的房间号和她的座位对不上。
building: The hearing will be held in the building opposite the main lobby.
听证会在主大厅对面的那栋楼宇里举行。
wing: Registration moved into the east wing while this side is renovated.
这边装修期间，挂号搬到了东侧楼翼。
ward: Visitors heading to the ward sign in at the nurses' station first.
要去病区的探视者，请先到护士站登记。
unit: The day surgery unit closes its counter at five on weekdays.
日间手术单元的柜台在工作日五点关闭。
bay: Families should wait outside bay three while the doctors are rounding.
医生查房的时候，家属请在三号床位区外面等候。
cubicle: The cubicle beside the window is set aside for staff counseling.
靠窗的那间隔间留给员工约谈用。
workstation area: The workstation area is too noisy for a private phone call.
工位区太吵，不适合打需要保密的电话。
quiet room: Please use the quiet room when a family needs a private talk.
家属需要私下谈话时，请使用安静室。
on-call room: The on-call room is at the far end of the east corridor.
值班室在东走廊的最尽头。
duty room: The night clerk rests in the duty room between phone calls.
夜班文员在两次来电之间，在值班房里休息。
changing room: The changing room on this floor is for hospital staff only.
这层楼的更衣室只供医院员工使用。
storage room: Spare visitor badges are kept in the storage room behind reception.
备用的访客工牌放在接待处后面的库房里。
records room: The records room closes fifteen minutes before the main counter.
病案室比总柜台早十五分钟关门。
medical records: Medical records can leave the room only with a signed request.
病案只有凭签字申请才能拿出房间。
chart request: A chart request from the outpatient clinic is waiting on this counter.
门诊提交的调阅病历申请正在这个柜台等着办。
release of information: Release of information requires the patient's written permission first.
办理信息调取，首先要有患者的书面许可。
authorization form: The family must sign an authorization form before we copy the chart.
我们复印病历之前，家属必须先签授权书。
identity check: We do an identity check before any chart leaves this counter.
任何病历离开这个柜台之前，我们都会做身份核验。
next of kin: Please ask for the next of kin when the patient cannot sign.
患者无法签字时，请询问近亲属。
emergency contact: The emergency contact written on the form is an old number.
表格上填的紧急联系人是一个旧号码。
guardian: A guardian has to sign when the patient is under eighteen.
患者未满十八岁时，必须由监护人签字。
interpreter: An interpreter will join the consent talk at three o'clock.
三点会有一位口译员参加知情同意的谈话。
language line: Call the language line when no interpreter is free on site.
现场没有空闲的口译员时，请打翻译专线。
plain explanation: Give a plain explanation before you ask the family to sign anything.
请家属在任何文件上签字之前，先做一遍通俗解释。
teach-back: Use teach-back so you know the family understood the visiting rules.
请用复述确认，看看家属是否真的听懂了探视规定。
informed consent: Informed consent has to be signed before the procedure is scheduled.
安排这项操作之前，必须先签署知情同意。
patient rights: The poster about patient rights hangs beside the registration desk.
关于患者权利的海报挂在挂号台旁边。
privacy screen: Please turn the privacy screen toward you before opening a chart.
打开病历之前，请把隐私屏转到朝向自己这一面。
last item: The last item on today's list is the holiday duty roster.
今天清单上的最后一项是假期值班表。
busy morning: It was a busy morning, and the queue reached the front lobby.
那是个忙碌的上午，队伍一直排到了前厅。
quiet afternoon: Use this quiet afternoon to finish the minutes from yesterday.
用这个清闲的下午把昨天的纪要写完。
heavy day: Monday was a heavy day because two clerks were off sick.
周一是繁忙的一天，因为有两名文员病休。
light day: Friday should be a light day if nobody adds another meeting.
如果不再加会，周五应该是轻松的一天。
typical day: A typical day here starts with the queue and ends with the logbook.
在这里，平常的一天从排队开始，以登记本结束。
unusual request: An unusual request arrived for a chart from twenty years ago.
来了一份少见的请求，要调二十年前的病历。
routine request: A routine request for a roster copy can wait until after lunch.
索要排班表副本这种常规请求，可以等到午饭以后。
special request: The health bureau made a special request for a private waiting room.
卫生局提出了一项特殊请求，要一间单独的等候室。
urgent request: An urgent request from the operating theatre just reached this desk.
手术室刚有一份紧急请求送到这个柜台。
standing request: We keep a standing request for a daily copy of the admission list.
我们有一份长期固定请求，每天要一份入院名单。
one-off request: Treat this as a one-off request and do not change the usual process.
把这个当作一次性请求，不要因此改动常规流程。
repeat request: This looks like a repeat request; we answered the same question last Tuesday.
这看起来是重复请求，同样的问题我们上周二已经回复过。
duplicate request: Ignore that duplicate request because the first form is already moving.
请忽略那份重复提交的请求，第一份表格已经在办了。
invalid request: An invalid request with no patient name cannot be processed today.
没有患者姓名的无效请求，今天无法办理。
incomplete form: Send any incomplete form back before it reaches the file room.
不完整的表格在送到档案室之前请退回去。
missing field: The missing field on page one is the patient's date of birth.
第一页的漏填字段是患者的出生日期。
wrong date: The wrong date on the leave form pushed the claim into last month.
请假表上日期填错了，这笔申报被算进了上个月。
illegible: The signature is illegible, so we cannot see who approved the form.
签名字迹难认，看不出是谁批准了这份表格。
unsigned: Return any unsigned leave form to the supervisor the same day.
未签字的请假表，请在当天退回给主管。
unstamped: An unstamped copy cannot stand in for a formal employment proof.
未盖章的副本不能代替正式的在职证明。
outdated: That lobby map is outdated and still shows the old pharmacy.
大厅那张图已经过时了，上面还标着旧药房。
superseded: This duty roster is superseded, so use the copy dated Monday.
这份值班表已经被替代了，请改用日期为周一的那份。
current version: The current version of the visitor rules is dated the first of May.
访客规定的当前版本，日期是五月一日。
obsolete version: Remove every obsolete version so staff do not follow the old steps.
请撤下每一份作废版本，免得员工还按旧步骤做。
controlled document: A controlled document has to show its version and its keeper.
受控文件必须标明版本和保管人。
uncontrolled copy: An uncontrolled copy must be marked so nobody files it by mistake.
非受控副本必须标明，免得有人误把它归档。
master copy: The master copy of the signed minutes stays in the locked drawer.
签过字的纪要正本放在上锁的抽屉里。
working copy: Mark your working copy clearly so nobody files it as the original.
请把你的工作副本标清楚，免得有人当成原件归档。
reference copy: A reference copy of the duty roster hangs on the staff board.
值班表的查阅副本挂在员工公告栏上。
display copy: The display copy at reception should be easy for families to read.
接待处那份展示用副本应该让家属容易看懂。
archived copy: The archived copy of last year's minutes is in box twelve.
去年纪要的归档副本在十二号箱里。
retention: The retention on visitor logs is two full years.
访客登记的保存期限是整整两年。
destruction: Destruction of old files needs two clerks and a signed log.
销毁旧档案需要两名文员，还要有一份签字记录。
shred: Please shred the extra copies once the minutes have been signed.
纪要签好之后，请把多余的副本粉碎销毁。
confidential bin: Drop the draft pay list into the confidential bin before you leave.
离开之前，请把工资草稿放进保密回收桶。
locked cabinet: Personnel files stay in the locked cabinet overnight.
人事档案夜间放在上锁柜里。
key control: Key control for the file room stays with the night supervisor.
档案室的钥匙管理由夜班主管负责。
access log: Please sign the access log each time you enter the file room.
每次进入档案室，请在进出记录上签名。
